parameters.query: SELECT id, name, timezone, settings FROM organizations WHERE id = $1::uuid;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ timeMin: DateTime.fromISO($json.window_start).toUTC().toISO(), timeMax: DateTime.fromISO($json.window_end).toUTC().toISO(), timeZone: $json.tz, items: [{ id: $json.calendar_id }] }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('start', start_at, 'end', end_at)), '[]'::jsonb) AS busy
FROM appointments
WHERE organization_id = $1::uuid AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','CONFIRMED')
  AND start_at < $3::timestamptz AND end_at > $2::timestamptz;

UPDATE leads
SET metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('offered_slots', $2::jsonb, 'offered_at', NOW())
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## 09 · Availability — never ask the AI what's free
Google `freeBusy` + our own active appointments → candidate slots inside business hours,
min-notice and horizon (all from `organizations.settings`) → at most 3 options.
The options are saved on the lead (`metadata.offered_slots`) so 04/10 can verify the customer picked a real one.
